editorial:
Imagine waking up from a nightmare only to find out that the murders you saw actually happened in real life. That is exactly what happens to Madison, a woman who starts seeing these scary flashes of a killer on the loose. At first, you think you are watching a standard ghost story or a creepy mystery, but the vibe quickly shifts. It feels like a wild ride where the movie keeps changing its mind about what it wants to be, moving from a spooky thriller to a full-blown action flick. It is weird, loud, and totally unpredictable, which makes it a blast to watch with a group of friends.

The biggest draw here is the massive twist in the second half that completely flips the script. The acting is solid, and the action scenes are filmed in a way that looks like a comic book come to life. While some of the plot points are a bit silly, that is part of the fun. If you want the best experience, you should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move. It is a perfect pick for anyone who loves movies that are just plain crazy.
endingExplained: You find out that Madison actually has a parasitic twin named Gabriel living inside her body. Gabriel can take over her motor skills, but he moves backward and upside down. This explains why the killer looked so strange. In the final fight, Madison and Gabriel battle for control of their shared body. Madison eventually wins by using a piece of glass to kill Gabriel, ending the nightmare and saving the day.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves crazy plot twists and over-the-top action.
